invariants.statement: The company system is the authoritative source for dispatch, project, procurement, cost, and audit records; LINE/Google Calendar cannot overwrite it.

evidence.claim: Company system is source of truth; LINE/Google Calendar must not overwrite official dispatch data.

invariants.statement: Authorization is Role + Scope + Permission from Phase 1.

evidence.claim: Authorization model is Role + Scope + Permission from Phase 1.

invariants.statement: One work assignment may contain one person, many people, or a whole crew; do not duplicate one assignment into separate dispatch records per person.

evidence.claim: Single dispatch can assign one, many, or a crew; duplicate per-person dispatch records are prohibited.

invariants.statement: A material dispatch amendment invalidates prior acknowledgements and requires re-acknowledgement.

evidence.claim: Dispatch amendment invalidates the original acknowledgement.

invariants.statement: Modifying a dispatch updates the same Google event and must not create duplicate events.

evidence.claim: Create/update/cancel mapping and no duplicate event on modification.

invariants.statement: Important changes preserve actor, time, function, before/after values, and related identifiers.

evidence.claim: Audit log requires actor, time, function, before/after, related IDs.

invariants.statement: Former employees are not hard-deleted when historical dispatch/cost records depend on them.

evidence.claim: Employee records and no hard delete after departure.

invariants.statement: AI can only access data the requesting user is already authorized to view.

evidence.claim: AI may only query data the user already has permission to see.

invariants.statement: The implementation uses one RWD web application; no native mobile app, separate mobile codebase, or installable PWA is part of the current project.
Offline browser state is bounded local cache/queued intent; the company system remains authoritative, queued writes are idempotent and conflict-checked before commit.

evidence.claim: Conditional invariant activated when bounded offline capability is selected.

invariants.statement: Dispatch is planned work assignment; actual attendance and approved labor time are separate records, and Phase 4 labor cost uses approved labor time rather than planned dispatch duration.

evidence.claim: Conditional invariant activated when separate actual/approved labor time is selected.

invariants.statement: Accounting synchronization uses a replaceable adapter, idempotent export/import semantics and reconciliation; accounting-provider records cannot silently overwrite operational source-of-truth records.

evidence.claim: Conditional invariant activated when accounting synchronization is selected.
